_doc: judge_cane.py fixtures. Boxes are [x0, y0, x1, y1) in the 512x224 frame. `state` names a private checkpoint (<states>/<state>.ps2st, never in the repository), `pad` the NATIVEEE_PAD_SCRIPT text (frame:buttons-hex:hold; SQUARE = 0x8000), `frames` the --frames count, `hold_keys` the --dump-frames f<key> keys judged (the charge pose, glow established ~45 frames after the press). `twin` = the PCSX2 2.7.329 SaveFrame of the same hold on the Paris ledge slot (pcsx2_cane.sh), by its f<frame> ordinal; `twin_box` its cane-head box (the ledge camera differs from the hub's).
